entities.summary: Inexhaustible Chalice is a wonderworking icon of the Mother of God which revealed itself in Serpukhov, Russia in 1878. The icon is venerated in the Russian Orthodox Church and has become known for healing those who suffer from alcoholism, drug abuse and other forms of addiction.
